verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks that fire on INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE table events. They are built as triggers using pg_net and deliver HTTP payloads to any endpoint, including Supabase Edge Functions (server-side TypeScript functions), so functions run automatically in response to database events. missing for 10: any evidence of functions triggered by auth events (e.g., auth hooks or sign-up triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook-to-function invocation.
